name: Foundation Settlement
description: Post-installation settlement of the monopile foundation. Checks whether tilt stays within operational tolerance.

elements.name: Foundation Tilt Angle
elements.description: Tilt of the turbine tower after foundation settlement. Uncertain due to soil heterogeneity.

uncertainty.source: Geotechnical survey and settlement prediction model

elements.name: Maximum Allowable Tilt
elements.description: Manufacturer and certification limit for tower verticality

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(θ_settle) = θ_settle if θ_settle <= θ_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The certification tilt limit guards the foundation settlement uncertainty set; tilts above 3.0 mrad increase fatigue loads and may void certification.
